integrity: The proof is reconstructed from the exact published scattering matrix and boundary relation. Finite computations replay the algebra and representative asymptotics but are not used as an infinite proof.
limitations: The critical formula excludes the singular curve where the leading denominator cancels.
The result is conditional on global spectral pairs and does not classify the full dispersion relation.
The right boundary and the finer singular scaling are outside the claim.
title: Critical \(1/k\) boundary layer for edge suppression in a preferred-orientation rectangular strip
